current: Every conversion a registry marks tradable either has its directed edge or is reported as a gap. qip_arbitrage::coverage::TradableRegistry holds what can be traded, one direction per entry (one side of one market's book at one venue, or one instrument moved from one venue to another), and ArbitrageGraph::coverage sorts every entry into covered or gap with no third outcome: an edge for one side of a book does not cover the other side. At the composition root, qip_edge_node::arbitrage::registry_from_books builds the registry from the books the cell holds (a source that is not the whitelist the graph is built from), ArbitrageInstaller::install checks the desk's graph against it, and a book side with no edge is returned as Installation::InstalledWithGaps, which is not quiet, so the tick logs the count and the labels. graph_from_whitelist still turns every whitelisted conversion into exactly one directed edge and refuses the whole whitelist when one cannot become an edge.
